# AML Detection and Internal Control Review

This document outlines key actions required for the bank's strategy 2026 concerning Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection and internal controls.

## Key Action Items:

*   Review the AML detection strategy for 2026.
*   Update internal controls based on recent audit findings.
*   Investigate AML detection processes on a quarterly basis.
*   Monitor updates to AML detection standards.
*   Investigate internal control effectiveness based on audit recommendations.
